'''PT04''' was the designation of a [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]]. PT04 was one of several pit droids owned by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Merchant/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], who offered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for sale along with its counterparts, [[PT02]] and [[PT03]], around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Most of the potential buyers were [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. Watto priced each of his pit droids at 1,000 [[Trugut/Legends|truguts]], selling them from his [[Wald's Parts|shop]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. PT04 was tan in [[Color/Legends|color]], and had a black colored shape on his torso.<ref name="SWR" />

==Behind the scenes==
PT04 and his counterparts first appeared in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'', where they cold be purchased by the player. The pit droids were used for repairing damaged parts on the player's Podracer. Damaged parts were repaired after the player successfully completed a newly unlocked course or a course that they hadn't beaten before.<ref name="SWR" />
